name: S&P 500 close
meaning: Latest daily close of the index.

name: Distance above 200-day average
meaning: The most-watched trend line on trading desks. Below it, losses historically clustered.

name: Distance from all-time high
meaning: No discount on offer: the index is at its record.

name: Stocks 20%+ below their 52-week high
rule: High share while index is at a record = narrow market
meaning: A few giants carry the index; broad participation is weak.

name: AAII bulls minus bears
rule: Extreme bearishness is a contrarian buy

name: Yield curve, 10Y minus 3M
meaning: Positive since late 2024. NY Fed recession model input.

name: Sahm rule
meaning: Unemployment is not rising fast enough to signal recession.

name: High-yield bond spread
meaning: Credit markets see little default risk (tight, possibly complacent).

name: Chicago Fed financial conditions
meaning: Conditions are loose, though slowly tightening since summer.

name: Fed funds rate (effective)
meaning: First hike in 3+ years in September; markets price another by December.

name: 10-year Treasury yield
meaning: Safe bonds now compete hard with stocks for money.

name: CPI inflation, year over year
meaning: Energy-driven; the reason the Fed is hiking.

name: Oil price, year to date
meaning: Mideast / Strait of Hormuz disruption and a Gulf hurricane.

name: Forward P/E (next 12m earnings)
meaning: Fairly priced if expected earnings arrive.

name: Shiller CAPE (10-yr real earnings)
meaning: Second highest in 155 years. Strong predictor of weak 10-year returns, weak for timing.

name: Equity risk premium (earnings yield − 10Y)
rule: Near 0 = stocks pay no extra over bonds
